sources.title: IMD 0.25-degree gridded rainfall at 22.50N 88.25E, 1970-2025 monthly
sources.license: IMD gridded product via imdlib, cited with attribution

provenance.note: 672 monthly records, 1970-2025, mean 1,659.3 mm. Grid point, not city centre.

note: Nearest valid land grid point to Kolkata. The city centre is 22.57 N, 88.36 E, but the Hooghly and the deltaic channels mean several nearby 0.25-deg cells are classified as water by IMD; 22.5/88.25 sits on land west of the river and covers the KMC plain
